\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\begin{document}
\section{Model}
The loss is
\begin{equation}
  \mathcal{L}(\theta) = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} (f_\theta(x_i) - y_i)^2 \label{eq:loss}
\end{equation}
and its gradient
\begin{equation}
  \nabla_\theta \mathcal{L} = \frac{2}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} (f_\theta(x_i) - y_i) \nabla_\theta f_\theta(x_i) \label{eq:grad}
\end{equation}
\section{Bounds}
For all $x \in \R^n$ we have
\begin{align}
  a &= b + c \label{eq:first} \\
  d &= e + f \label{eq:second}
\end{align}
and finally
\begin{equation}
  E = m c^2 \label{eq:energy}
\end{equation}
which ends the section.
